recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E（箭頭標示）：黑色箭頭指出大型中心母細胞（核圓、泡狀染色質、靠核膜的小核仁），藍色與白色箭頭指出較小、有角或裂紋核的中心細胞；視野中中心母細胞數量多（>15/高倍視野）但仍有中心細胞夾雜，並見分裂像，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤 3a 級。
features: Numerous centroblasts: large cells with round vesicular nuclei and 1-3 peripheral nucleoli (black arrows)
Admixed centrocytes: small to medium cells with angulated, cleaved nuclei (blue and white arrows)
Centroblasts exceed 15 per high-power field while centrocytes remain present
Scant cytoplasm and monotonous germinal-center cell population without tingible body macrophages
describe_en: High-power view of a neoplastic follicle shows a crowded population of germinal-center cells. Numerous centroblasts, large cells with round vesicular nuclei and one to three peripherally located nucleoli (black arrows), are admixed with centrocytes, small to medium cells with angulated and cleaved nuclei (blue and white arrows); scattered mitotic figures are present and tingible body macrophages are not seen. The centroblasts exceed 15 per high-power field, but centrocytes are still clearly present and there are no solid sheets of centroblasts. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3a.

ddx.vs: Grade 3b follicles are composed of solid sheets of centroblasts without admixed centrocytes.
Low-grade FL contains 15 or fewer centroblasts per high-power field with a predominance of centrocytes.
DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without follicular architecture or follicular dendritic cell meshworks (CD21/CD23).
Reactive germinal centers show polarization, abundant tingible body macrophages and BCL2-negative germinal-center cells.
